description_for_human: AI-powered prediction market intelligence. Get real-time analysis of trending Polymarket markets.
description_for_model: Use PolyLens to fetch AI-analyzed prediction market insights from Polymarket. Call get_insights to retrieve the latest market movements with probability changes, AI summaries, and key drivers. Use get_market_summary for a quick overview. Optionally filter by category: politics, ai_tech, economy, business, world, sports, crypto. Supports English and Chinese (lang: en/zh).
